flags: Scope is the inland Cornell–Las Virgenes segment in the catalog, not the entire Mulholland Highway or Mulholland Drive. Caltrans also designates a separate coastal segment.

The cache supplies little segment-specific road character and no drive time, builder or campaign history. Caltrans confirms designation but gives no descriptive rationale; the overview avoids attributing an unsupported evaluation to the agency.
No unsupported current-story historical claims needed removal. Reframed the highway crossing as passage through the park rather than establishing an exact crossing of former Fox property.
The added temple is a separate excursion near the eastern end; coordinates come from its cache page. Rituals are described as continuing practice, not as promised visitor experiences.
Malibou Lake is private. No public lake access or present post-fire access to historic structures is implied.
Century Lake construction dates conflict (1903 versus 1910); the lake and park articles also disagree with Malibou Lake about the Butch Cassidy stunt location. Neither disputed claim is used.
Overview is shorter than 200 words because the designated inland segment has little cached driving description; no full-highway length is substituted.
